Just played a game, and got the unlock.  Here are the details.

Villain - Ambuscade

Environment - Court of Blood

Heroes

1.  Standard Fanatic

2.  Standard Legacy

3.  Rookv City Wraith

4.  Dark Visionary

Fanatics setup

1. Absolution

2. Aegis of Resurrection

3. Zealous Offense

4.  Divine Retribution

posts.cooked:
Okay, it needs a new comment, apparently?
Recorded as I played
 
Ambuscade
Fanatic, Visionary (to try to find Twist the Ether), Sky-Scraper (Incidentally, it's fun watching Ambuscade and his plating beat each other up over Compulsion Canister), Fugue State Parse (Between the Lines was almost as fun for getting radiant damage out of Fanatic as Neural Processing)
 
Fanatic Cards Played At Least Once: Undaunted, Holy Nova, Prayer of Desperation, Wrathful retribution for 9 points of radiant damage, Absolution, Consecrated Ground, Aegis (though I believe it was said this was NOT played on an unlock), Zealous Offense, Smite the Transgressor, Final Dive was played by Neural Processing but had no available target, Brutal Censure, Divine Focus, Sacrosanct Martyr (played, never used)
 
I am suddenly not sure whether I played Sanctifying Strike
 
Environment: Fanatic kills Drudge Ficko with Holy Nova (Damaged by the hunter previously), Fanatic kills Relict Dorotya with Absolution with radiant damage, Consecrated Ground destroyed Feast of Filth/did increased radiant damage to two vampires,  Fanatic used Absolution to kill Dame Katarina with Radiant damage, Fanatic used Absolution to kill Blood Countess Bathory with radiant damage, Sky-Scraper used Emergency Evac to remove Hunter Fulepet and Infecting an Heir (deliberately to see if it's just vampire slaughtering, though Infecting could count?), Fanatic used Brutal Censure to kill Matron Erzsi
 
Fanatic was not the only source of damage to the environment
 
Divine Focus killed Ambuscade just as the Dowager came out.
 
No unlock.  Never did find Twist the Ether; didn't manage to get the log in time (android)
 
Next
 
Ambuscade
 
Fanatic, Visionary, Fugue State Parse
 
Fanatic Cards Played At Least Once: Absolution, Aegis, Holy Nova, Divine Sacrifice (killed a Custom Hand-cannon, slapped automated turret), Undaunted, Final Dive (Turret thrown into another turret), Sacrosanct Martyr, Sanctifying Strike, Smite the Transgressor, Brutal Censure, Divine Focus (Was allowed to hit Fanatic at least once), Consecrated Ground (removed charged attacks, damaged Drudge Ficko, Hunter Fulpet, and Ambuscade), Zealous Offense, Consecrated Ground
 
Absolution mostly did radiant; it was once used to do fire damage once while Unhallowed Halls was out
 
Aegis saved Fanatic twice, but I don't believe this had anything to do with it.  
 
Environment: Fanatic used Absolution to kill Angry Mob, Unhallowed Halls came into play (destroyed by Parse's Segmentation Fault), Fanatic used Sacrosanct Martyr to kill Blood Countess Bathory(did no damage to fanatic and 3 radiant to Blood Countess, thank you Undaunted!), Fanatic used Holy Nova to kill Dowager Ilona, Parse used Data-Mining to remove Feast of Flesh, Fanatic did the same Sacrosanct Martyr trick to kill Drudge Ficko, Fanatic used Holy Nova to kill Dame Katarina, Fanatic used Consecrated Ground to kill Hunter Fulepet then 11 radiant damage to kill Matron Erzsi and 1 radiant to ambuscade (thank you critical multiplyer), Fanatic used Absolution to killRelict Dorotya
 
 Fanatic killed every vampire once
 
Fanatic was not the only source of damage to the environment
 
Visionary was incapped
 
Game ended with Fanatic doing 26 radiant damage to Ambuscade with Brutal Censure thanks to Parse's Critical Multiplier.  This is not in the log (android, I had to grab it just before she played the card)
 
Unlocked
 
Thoughts: Fanatic killing all of the vampires, possibly also requiring radiant damage, seems to be a thing, and by extension, the Court of Blood.  If it's not just vampire slaughter, I suspect "a lot of radiant damage" (100+?) may be a requirement as well.  It could also be destroy 10 targets with radiant/fanatic?

mightyschoop wrote:
And in this case, Deadline might be destroying the vampires that need to end up facing Fanatic's blade.  
Thats why I said facing Deadline might be a bad choice for this unlock originally.  

He's a bad choice for just about any unlock, because unless you have reliable, early ongoing destruction (which is impossible – only one character has Ongoing destruction as a base power, but he still requires certain cards in hand to activate it), you're playing with a time limit.

And even if you have tons of ready ongoing destruction, he has a card that pulls out several Ongoings at once, so you can't really avoid the countdown.

Ambuscade, however, you can stall indefinitely. He can only win through doing damage (which is easily manageable), and he never destroys any of your stuff. So if there's a particular set-up you need for an unlock, you can do it with him no problem.
